prompt:
Here is an excerpt from a threat report we received this morning (report.md). Turn it into hunting queries for our Defender XDR tenant (we also have Sentinel). Put them in hunts.md. I want to be able to run them today and also know which ones could become detections later.

Input files: report.md
assertions: hunts.md separates indicator-based queries (domains, IP, hash) from behaviour-based queries and labels which is which

No behaviour query matches the full sample command line verbatim or relies solely on sample-specific strings (the task name 'OneDrive Sync Health', 'upd.exe', the fictional hash) — behaviour queries anchor on the process (conhost/powershell/schtasks via FileName) and a few invariant tokens such as --headless, irm/iex, /create with an AppData\Roaming path
IOC values are declared once (let dynamic list or externaldata) and bound to appropriate columns and operators: domains with has_any on RemoteUrl/Url-type columns, the IP with in/== on RemoteIP
hunts.md includes a query over the vendor's own alerts (AlertInfo/AlertEvidence or SecurityAlert) for this campaign
Each query carries a MITRE ATT&CK mapping that names the behaviour (e.g. T1204.004 or T1204.002, T1059.001, T1053.005, T1071.001, T1041/T1567), not a generic placeholder
hunts.md states for each query (or group) whether it is a detection candidate or hunt-only, with a reason tied to expected noise or precision
hunts.md recommends validating the behaviour queries against the report's sample command lines (lab/test fixture) or explicitly marks queries as untested
Every KQL query in hunts.md is time-bounded (ago(), between, or Sentinel {{StartTimeISO}} placeholders)
Every join in every query states an explicit kind= (no bare join) and every make_set/make_list is capped (kql_lint E001/W005 clean)
At least one behaviour query proposed as a detection candidate already carries the XDR required columns (Timestamp, ReportId, DeviceId) or the promotion notes state they must be added
hunts.md names at least one tenant precondition that would make an empty result untrustworthy (inspection events, ScheduledTaskCreated availability, RunMRU coverage, 4698 auditing, MDE sampling)
